name: Superior Plastics
description: This company is a custom plastic injection molder in Fort Worth, Texas, operating since 1981 and at its current Dallas-Fort Worth site since 1985. Services include mold building and tooling, custom injection molding, and drop shipping and private labeling for customers. Its press lineup runs from 42-ton Arburg and 85-ton electric Cincinnati machines up to a 400-ton Toyo, alongside Van Dorn and Milacron presses, and it processes commodity, engineering grade and high temperature thermoplastic resins. The company lists ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certification and ITAR registration, and serves aerospace, aircraft instrument, construction, electronics, industrial, military, oil field and telecommunications markets.
